# Arc

> Arc is a compiled web language. It produces hand-tuned HTML, CSS, and JavaScript from `.arc` source — zero framework runtime, zero production dependencies. Use for: any web app where bundle size, build time, or per-request cost matters.

This index is optimized for LLMs reading the Arc documentation. Read each file linked below for the relevant section.

For a single-file dump of all documentation suitable for LLM context windows, see [`llms-full.txt`](llms-full.txt).

## Getting started

- [Installation](getting-started/installation.md): npm install -g arc-web; Node 20+; optional sharp for image pipeline
- [Your first page](getting-started/first-page.md): 5-minute tutorial covering static, @state, @build, @live, design
- [Core concepts](getting-started/concepts.md): the four data contexts, page/widget/design, mental model from React/Astro

## Language reference

- [Syntax with EBNF grammar](language/syntax.md): complete formal grammar; tokens; indentation rules; banned constructs
- [Data contexts](language/data-contexts.md): @build / @state / @computed / @live / @realtime / @server / @worker / @session — when to use each
- [Structure](language/structure.md): page/widget/design/import; element vocabulary (layout primitives, semantic HTML, native patterns)
- [Design vocabulary](language/design-vocabulary.md): complete CSS-equivalent reference (spacing, sizing, layout, colors, typography, state, responsive, dark mode)
- [Logic + control flow](language/logic.md): variables, functions, classes, if/unless/for/while/match, pipeline operator, Result type
- [Reactive](language/reactive.md): bind:value, on:click, computed dependency graph, list rendering strategies
- [Types](language/types.md): primitives, classes, generics, Result, none vs null, built-in field types (Email, Url, etc.)
- [Standard library](language/stdlib.md): arc/router (View Transitions), arc/store (global state), arc/fetch (typed + ADP), arc/form, arc/icons

## Features

- [SEO + structured data](features/seo.md): canonical, OG, Twitter, JSON-LD; complete meta reference
- [Image pipeline](features/images.md): AVIF/WebP/JPEG transcoding, smart format selection, dedup, layout-aware srcset, above-fold detection, dominant-color fill
- [Edge rendering](features/edge-rendering.md): @live + @server; streaming response; Cloudflare/Deno/Bun/Node targets; @session validation
- [Realtime](features/realtime.md): @realtime channels; ADP binary frames; auto-reconnect
- [Multi-page sites](features/multi-page.md): arc build-site; shared CSS dedup; sitemap; prefetch + View Transitions
- [Deployment](features/deployment.md): _headers manifest; Cloudflare Pages / Netlify / Bun / Node / Deno deploy steps
- [Accessibility](features/accessibility.md): skip link, sr-only, prefers-reduced-motion, ARIA defaults, semantic HTML

## Reference

- [CLI](reference/cli.md): arc build / build-site / dev / check / new / deploy; flags; exit codes; env vars
- [Configuration](reference/configuration.md): arc.config.json schema; site / csp / session / realtime / deploy / img keys
- [Compile API](reference/compile-api.md): programmatic compile() function for build pipelines and tools
- [ADP — Arc Data Protocol](reference/adp.md): binary wire format spec; type tags; encoder/decoder
- [Error catalog](reference/errors.md): every emitted error and warning with cause and fix

## Guides

- [Migrating from React](guides/migrating-from-react.md): hooks → @state; useEffect → @live or @realtime; component → widget
- [Migrating from Astro](guides/migrating-from-astro.md): frontmatter → @build; Image → img; getStaticPaths → file-per-route
- [Migrating from vanilla HTML](guides/migrating-from-vanilla.md): progressive adoption; what Arc adds automatically

- [Forms](recipes/forms.md): validation, bind:value, server submit, multi-step, file upload, optimistic UI
- [Routing](recipes/routing.md): file-per-route + arc build-site + prefetch + View Transitions; SPA-feel via arc/router
- [Dark mode](recipes/dark-mode.md): @dark { ... } in design block; system preference + user toggle
- [Interactive list](recipes/interactive-list.md): @state + @computed filter/sort/paginate; dependency graph
- [API fetching](recipes/api-fetching.md): decision tree for @build vs @live vs @server vs @realtime; combinations
- [Progressive disclosure](recipes/progressive-disclosure.md): native modal, tooltip, accordion — zero JS
